name: Post Event Resolutions (RN)
description: Post Event Resolutions a business documents record. Part of the Business Documents APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

Auth-Key.description: Company auth key. Send this or Session-Id. One is required.

Session-Id.description: Logged-in user session. Send this or Auth-Key. One is required.

event.description: Event. Allowed values: RETURN, LOSS. Optional.
